messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: PyStan OS X Install Issue
parts:
I’m trying to install PyStan on Mavericks — cython and numpy install easily enough (after taking into
account the bad distribution of the default Python in Mavericks) but pystan fails with the following error,

error: can't copy 'pystan/_api.c': doesn't exist or not a regular file

Any ideas on how to proceed?

Allen — by the way, the install doc claims numpy 1.6.2 as a requirement but pystan 2.2.0.0 requires
1.7.1.

messages.author: 17d9c7a6e1a581b8
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] PyStan OS X Install Issue
parts:

> I'm trying to install PyStan on Mavericks -- cython and numpy install easily enough (after taking into

> account the bad distribution of the default Python in Mavericks) but pystan fails with the following error,
>
> error: can't copy 'pystan/_api.c': doesn't exist or not a regular file

I'll just double check on this since it's the most likely cause: are you sure
you have Cython 0.19+?

How are you installing? Via source or pip?

>
> Any ideas on how to proceed?
>

> Allen -- by the way, the install doc claims numpy 1.6.2 as a requirement but pystan 2.2.0.0 requires
> 1.7.1.

Thanks -- I should explicitly test against one of those. 1.6.2 is the version
in the older Ubuntu LTS. But since the version of Cython shipped with that will
not work, I might as well pin to 1.7.1.

Best wishes,

-a
